AWAKE.Title: Awake — Unofficial Don't Rest Your Head System

Validation.FightCheckedExceedsTotal: Checked Fight responses cannot exceed total Fight responses.
Validation.FlightCheckedExceedsTotal: Checked Flight responses cannot exceed total Flight responses.
Validation.ResponseAllocation: Fight and Flight totals must allocate exactly zero or three responses.
Validation.DisciplineMadnessTotal: Discipline and Permanent Madness must always add up to three.

Scars.TransformWarning: A transformed Scar is permanently crossed out and can never be recalled or transformed again.
Scars.TransformReminder: When you transform a Scar, choose one: change your Madness Talent, change your Exhaustion Talent, or gain the equivalent of 5 Hope.

ExhaustionTalent.MinorUseText: Your Degree cannot be lower than your current Exhaustion.
ExhaustionTalent.MajorUseText: Increase Exhaustion by 1, then add your current Exhaustion to the Degree.

Hope.SpendDescription: Each Hope coin adds a 1 to the protagonist's Discipline pool.
Hope.InvalidAmount: Choose at least one Hope coin.
Hope.NotEnough: There is not enough Hope in the Chalice.
Hope.RecoveryHint: Spend Hope outside of conflicts. Restoring Discipline normally requires several hours of calm reflection.
Hope.ActionUnavailable: This Hope action is no longer available.

Despair.EmptyPool: A 6 cannot be added to an empty pool.
Despair.NoSix: That pool does not contain a 6.
Despair.NoSixesAvailable: There are no sixes available to remove.

Consequences.DisciplineDescription: Choose one benefit of Discipline dominance.
Consequences.MadnessDescription: Choose one available Response to check.
Consequences.SnapDescription: No Responses remain available. The character must Snap.
Consequences.SnapWarning: Snapping clears all Responses, reduces Discipline by 1, and adds 1 Permanent Madness.
Consequences.SnapNotice: SNAP — Responses are cleared, Discipline falls by 1, and Permanent Madness increases by 1.
Consequences.NightmareNotice: SNAP — The protagonist has lost their final Discipline die and becomes a Nightmare.
Consequences.FailureDescription: The action failed. The GM may inflict one additional consequence.
Consequences.FailureSnapWarning: No Responses remain available. Choosing a Response consequence will cause a Snap.
Consequences.DisciplineClearedFight: Discipline dominates — one Fight Response cleared.
Consequences.DisciplineClearedFlight: Discipline dominates — one Flight Response cleared.
Consequences.MadnessCheckedFight: Madness dominates — one Fight Response checked.
Consequences.MadnessCheckedFlight: Madness dominates — one Flight Response checked.
Consequences.PainNoDespair: Pain dominates — no Despair gained because the dominance was caused by Cast Shadow.

Conflict.Title: Conflict
Conflict.GMOnly: Only the GM can start a conflict.
Conflict.InvalidActor: The selected protagonist could not be found.
Conflict.InvalidPain: Pain must be a whole number of at least 1.
Conflict.NotYourProtagonist: You do not own this protagonist.
Conflict.InvalidTemporaryMadness: Temporary Madness must be a whole number from 0 to 6.
Conflict.InvalidConflict: The conflict could not be found.
Conflict.AlreadyRolled: This conflict has already been rolled.
Conflict.NoActiveGM: No active GM is available to receive the conflict roll.

Recovery.Title: Restore from Crash
Recovery.Heading: Crash Recovery
Recovery.Description: Restore a character after the required period of sleep and wakefulness has passed.
Recovery.RecoveryDiscipline: Discipline does not match the character's Crash recovery state.
Recovery.NotRecovering: This character is not recovering from a Crash.
Recovery.TalentsUnavailable: Talents are unavailable while recovering from a Crash.
Recovery.CrashNotice: CRASH — Exhaustion is cleared, Responses are reset, Discipline falls to 1, and Talents are unavailable until recovery.

Chalices.Title: Hope and Despair Chalices
Chalices.GMOnly: Only the GM can change the Chalices.
